mapper.insert: INSERT INTO transaction_states ( ticket_id, seller_id, buyer_id, transaction_status ) VALUES ( #{kakaoPayApproveResponse.ticketId}, #{kakaoPayApproveResponse.sellerId}, #{kakaoPayApproveResponse.buyerId}, #{kakaoPayApproveResponse.transactionStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT t.* FROM tickets t JOIN transaction_states ts ON t.ticket_id = ts.ticket_id WHERE ts.transaction_id = #{transactionId}
